features.note: Pin entire tested TOC0/SPL/BL31/U-Boot prefix; earlier RAM experiments must not become default.
Shared CPU/WLAN/GPU supply code: keep the base parts when GPU is omitted.
Reset relocation is present with rewritten context in final dwmac-sun8i.c; not an absent patch.
Final driver byte-identical to v8. Historical PWM patch is superseded, not reapplied afterwards.
XR819 firmware, MAC80211/CFG80211, SDIO and late ALDO2 registration; no synchronous pre-init hardware operations.
Display uses IOMMU too. Do not remove shared SRAM/IOMMU merely because Cedrus is disabled.
DE33/display graph/mixer IOMMU remain enabled without Panfrost and Cedrus.
AHUB/analog codec share PLL; retain coordinated rate locking and HDMI BCLK correction.
Retain tested FD655 runtime, not obsolete display experiments.
Proposed built-in hardware allocation; rc-core+sunxi-cir, keep verified configuration.
Shared cfg80211/mac80211 and USB core remain base; extra USB drivers and modem userspace only in A.
Panfrost is currently built-in. Tested ANA-provider module resides outside /lib/modules. Preserve its BL31/security assumptions; do not substitute failed PPU experiment.
Seven-patch VE series, DT ports/SRAM, V4L2/videobuf2 and Request-aware userspace required.

Required next profile extension: MEDIA_USB_SUPPORT, VIDEO_DEV and USB_VIDEO_CLASS/UVC including vb2 dependencies. Current tested kernel has MEDIA_USB_SUPPORT disabled. USB audio already belongs to base. Select additional analog grabber drivers (USBTV/STK1160/EM28XX/CX231XX) by supported device IDs; include required subdrivers/firmware, do not promise every USB grabber.

Resolve capture-to-network userspace per OS: V4L2 capture, audio capture, parsers, muxers and chosen network sink/protocol; software encoder only where needed. Current GStreamer base set does not prove a complete streaming pipeline. Prefer passthrough of device-encoded video where supported. Does not require profile A or Cedrus hardware encoding; H616 hardware encoder is not integrated. No automatic streaming service, firewall opening or publishing.
